correctness.rationale: PASS: Checked the unique stationary solution from positive stiffnesses, the 2x2 linear systems for state-resolved second moments u_i=D(b+k)/(2ab+k(a+b)), D(a+k)/(2ab+k(a+b)), and covariance C(t)=u^T exp(t[[-a-k,k],[k,-b-k]])1. Its characteristic ODE has L=a+b+2k, P=ab+k(a+b), initial C(0)=D L/[2ab+k(a+b)] and C'(0)=-D. Enforcing one exponential yields the exact factor (ab-k^2)(4ab-(a+b)^2)=0; distinct a,b force ab=k^2 and conversely uniqueness of the ODE gives the asserted entire covariance. Independently recomputed the 4th-moment generator inverse and the positive cumulant 3D^2(a-b)^2(4ab+3k(a+b)+2k^2)/[(2ab+k(a+b))^2(4ab+k(a+b))] using SymPy, and verified factorization exactly. Prior published joint entropy formula Sigma=k(a-b)^2/[4ab+2k(a+b)] reduces algebraically to stated identity. AM-GM and a->infty with b=k^2/a establish positivity, calibration and unboundedness. Claim is covariance-only, not full OU law.
